question: How much residual moisture did the water-processed NMC532 cathode lose between 20 °C and drying at 120 °C, and how does its final value compare with the NMP-processed cathode dried at 100 °C?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page = 8 AND (text ILIKE '%moisture%' OR text ILIKE '%ppm%' OR text ILIKE '%respectively%' OR text ILIKE '%20%C%') ORDER BY id

SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(a.text,'and (\d+) ppm of',1) AS INT) - CAST(regexp_extract(b.text,'and (\d+) ppm by',1) AS INT) AS loss, CAST(regexp_extract(c.text,'to (\d+) ppm after',1) AS INT) - CAST(regexp_extract(b.text,'and (\d+) ppm by',1) AS INT) AS gap FROM lines a, lines b, lines c WHERE a.id='p8.L54' AND b.id='p8.L59' AND c.id='p8.L56'
